11pub(crate) fn show_text_string<'a>(ctx: &mut Context<'a>, device: &mut impl Device<'a>, resources: &Resources<'a>, text: &object::String<'_>) {
12    let Some(font) = ctx.get().text_state.font.clone() else {
13        warn!("tried to show text without active font");
14
15        return;
16    };
17
18    let bytes = text.as_bytes();
19
20    // In case we have a fallback font (which occurs if either no font was set at all
21    // in the content stream, or an invalid one), we only want to show the glyphs
22    // using Helvetica if the bytes are actually valid ASCII.
23    let show_glyphs = matches!(font, TextStateFont::Font(_)) || (matches!(font, TextStateFont::Fallback(_)) && bytes.is_ascii());
24
25    let mut cur_idx = 0;
26
27    while cur_idx < bytes.len() {
28        let (code, adv) = font.read_code(bytes, cur_idx);
29        cur_idx += adv;
30
31        if show_glyphs {
32            let (glyph, glyph_transform) = font.get_glyph(font.map_code(code), code, ctx, resources, font.origin_displacement(code));
33            show_glyph(ctx, device, &glyph, glyph_transform);
34        }
35
36        ctx.get_mut().text_state.apply_code_advance(code, adv);
37    }
38}

40pub(crate) fn next_line(ctx: &mut Context<'_>, tx: f64, ty: f64) {
41    let new_matrix = ctx.get_mut().text_state.text_line_matrix * Affine::translate((tx, ty));
42    ctx.get_mut().text_state.text_line_matrix = new_matrix;
43    ctx.get_mut().text_state.text_matrix = new_matrix;
44}

46pub(crate) fn show_glyph<'a>(ctx: &mut Context<'a>, device: &mut impl Device<'a>, glyph: &Glyph<'a>, glyph_transform: Affine) {
47    if !ctx.ocg_state.is_visible() {
48        return;
49    }
50
51    device.set_soft_mask(ctx.get().graphics_state.soft_mask.clone());
52    device.set_blend_mode(ctx.get().graphics_state.blend_mode);
53    let stroke_props = ctx.stroke_props();
54
55    // PdfCraft patch: text in a Type 3 font is rendered from its glyph descriptions in every mode
56    // but 3 and 7 (ISO 32000-2 §9.3.6). Stroking ran the glyph procedure a second time, so
57    // `2 Tr` made bitmap fonts look bold.
58    // PdfCraft patch (64): in modes 3 and 7 the text "shall not be rendered" (§9.3.6); `7 Tr`
59    // painted the glyphs in the fill colour. It is still reported as clipping text, but in
60    // modes 4 to 7 "nothing shall be added to the clipping path" (`clip_glyph`).
61    let render_mode = match (glyph, ctx.get().text_state.render_mode) {
62        (Glyph::Type3(_), TextRenderingMode::Invisible) => TextRenderingMode::Invisible,
63        (Glyph::Type3(_), TextRenderingMode::Clip) => TextRenderingMode::Clip,
64        (Glyph::Type3(_), _) => TextRenderingMode::Fill,
65        (_, mode) => mode,
66    };
67
68    match render_mode {
69        TextRenderingMode::Fill => {
70            device.draw_glyph(glyph, ctx.get().ctm, glyph_transform, &get_paint(ctx, false), &GlyphDrawMode::Fill);
71        }
72        TextRenderingMode::Stroke => {
73            device.draw_glyph(glyph, ctx.get().ctm, glyph_transform, &get_paint(ctx, true), &GlyphDrawMode::Stroke(stroke_props));
74        }
75        TextRenderingMode::FillStroke => {
76            with_fill_stroke_group(ctx, device, |ctx, device| {
77                device.draw_glyph(glyph, ctx.get().ctm, glyph_transform, &get_paint(ctx, false), &GlyphDrawMode::Fill);
78                device.draw_glyph(glyph, ctx.get().ctm, glyph_transform, &get_paint(ctx, true), &GlyphDrawMode::Stroke(stroke_props));
79            });
80        }
81        TextRenderingMode::Invisible => {
82            // Still call draw_glyph for invisible text, so that it can
83            // for example be used for text extraction.
84            device.draw_glyph(glyph, ctx.get().ctm, glyph_transform, &get_paint(ctx, false), &GlyphDrawMode::Invisible);
85        }
86        TextRenderingMode::Clip => {
87            clip_glyph(ctx, glyph, glyph_transform);
88            // PdfCraft patch: report clipping text separately from invisible OCR text.
89            // Extraction filters must retain text that is filled through its
90            // clipping path without rendering devices drawing it directly.
91            device.draw_glyph(glyph, ctx.get().ctm, glyph_transform, &get_paint(ctx, false), &GlyphDrawMode::Clip);
92        }
93        TextRenderingMode::FillAndClip => {
94            clip_glyph(ctx, glyph, glyph_transform);
95            device.draw_glyph(glyph, ctx.get().ctm, glyph_transform, &get_paint(ctx, false), &GlyphDrawMode::Fill);
96        }
97        TextRenderingMode::StrokeAndClip => {
98            clip_glyph(ctx, glyph, glyph_transform);
99            device.draw_glyph(glyph, ctx.get().ctm, glyph_transform, &get_paint(ctx, true), &GlyphDrawMode::Stroke(stroke_props));
100        }
101        TextRenderingMode::FillAndStrokeAndClip => {
102            clip_glyph(ctx, glyph, glyph_transform);
103            with_fill_stroke_group(ctx, device, |ctx, device| {
104                device.draw_glyph(glyph, ctx.get().ctm, glyph_transform, &get_paint(ctx, false), &GlyphDrawMode::Fill);
105                device.draw_glyph(glyph, ctx.get().ctm, glyph_transform, &get_paint(ctx, true), &GlyphDrawMode::Stroke(stroke_props));
106            });
107        }
108    }
109}

111pub(crate) fn clip_glyph(context: &mut Context<'_>, glyph: &Glyph<'_>, transform: Affine) {
112    match glyph {
113        Glyph::Outline(o) => {
114            let outline = transform * o.outline();
115            let has_outline = outline.segments().next().is_some();
116
117            if has_outline {
118                context.get_mut().text_state.clip_paths.extend(outline);
119            }
120        }
121        // PdfCraft patch (64): a Type 3 glyph adds nothing to the clipping path in modes 4 to 7
122        // (ISO 32000-2 §9.3.6), so text shown only in a Type 3 font leaves no clip at `ET`.
123        Glyph::Type3(_) => {}
124    }
125}

127#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Default)]
128pub(crate) enum TextRenderingMode {
129    #[default]
130    Fill,
131    Stroke,
132    FillStroke,
133    Invisible,
134    FillAndClip,
135    StrokeAndClip,
136    FillAndStrokeAndClip,
137    Clip,
138}
